notes.title: Reworked Boss Fights & Card Buffs
notes.content:
Dear players,

First and foremost, thank you for your passionate support of Lost for Swords! We're thrilled to bring you substantial updates in this patch:

[h3][b]This update focuses on two key aspects:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] Optimizing the onboarding experience for new players, ensuring all Tower adventurers can more smoothly explore our content.
[*] Implementing card buffs based on community feedback, opening up fresh deck-building possibilities! 
[/olist]
[h3][b]Here are the details：[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] reworked (most) boss fights: reduced boss phases to 1, increased boss HP
[*] adjusted difficulty of Gathering Tower: reduced Monsters on first four floors
[*] adjusted difficulty of Dark Tower: added Tangle Root and Lead Root, appear in rotation with Void Root
[*] adjusted Shield Slam: ignores boss as target if boss is immune
[*] added Foresight to Thief starter deck
[*] improved room fill animation
[*] improved room leave animation
[*] added hint for how many monsters are left to defeat on room select screen
[*] filled empty spot in peddler room, so you can't get stuck anymore when teleporting
[*] reworked basic Rogue tutorial to not include any moving monsters
[*] reworked advanced Rogue tutorial to explain moving monsters
[*] reworked advanced Mage tutorial to explain moving monsters
[*] added popup before entering gathering tower, hinting at advanced tutorial
[*] increased reward for completing abstinence quest
[*] buffed Steadfast Hammer: gets +1 Use when Armor loses Defense
[*] buffed Divine Ring: +1 damage increase
[*] buffed Mana Rain: +1 damage per Mana Orb
[*] buffed Niv's Presence: +1 damage
[*] buffed Potion Of Fire: +1 damage
[*] buffed Shrine Of Protection: +3 Defense for Hero
[*] buffed Greater Heal: +1 healing per upgrade
[*] buffed Bristle Ring: +1 damage
[*] buffed Infused Sword: +1 damage increase, +1 damage increase per upgrade
[*] buffed Mana Staff: +2 damage, +1 damage increase per upgrade
[*] buffed Hungry Sword: +1 attack increase per upgrade, +1 base attack per upgrade
[*] buffed Mimic Staff: +1 repeat of effects, +1 repeat per upgrade
[*] added option for faster room animations
[*] improved text rendering of cards
[*] bugfix for monster achievements not unlocking
[/list]
Following through on our commitments, we'll continue actively monitoring community feedback to deliver further content updates. Your voices are vital in shaping Lost for Swords' evolution.

Keep sharing your thoughts through our official channels - together, we'll forge the ultimate card adventuring experience!

— MaxBytes & Astrolabe Games

notes.title: Workshop Support, QoL Improvements - Lost for Swords Will See Long-Term Updates
notes.content:
Dear players,

It’s been just over a week since the launch of Lost for Swords, and we’re incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from players around the world. At the same time, we’ve been listening closely to all the feedback from the community—we want to assure you that we've heard you, and that Lost for Swords will continue to evolve.

[h3][b]After much discussion, we’re excited to share that Lost for Swords will continue to receive long-term updates — with a roadmap to be revealed in the coming weeks.[/b][/h3]

The planned upcoming updates will address almost all aspects of the game, including (but not limited to):

[b]Workshop Support[/b] – Create, share, and explore community-made content
[b]Difficulty Curve Adjustments[/b] – Smoother progression across all towers and floors
[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b] – UI, navigation, and overall experience enhancements
[b]Gameplay Refinement[/b] – Sharper mechanics, tighter balance, and better synergy
[b]And of course… more content![/b] – Yes, the stuff you’ve all been asking for

We're still fine-tuning the roadmap because, as you know, Lost for Swords is a strategic game that thrives on calculation, precision, balance, and thoughtful design. We want to ensure that every major addition is meaningful and enjoyable for all players.

In the meantime, if you have more suggestions or ideas, we’d love to hear them through any of our community channels.

Thank you once again for your passion and support—we couldn’t do this without you.

— MaxBytes & Astrolabe Games

notes.title: Cloud Save Now Fixed and Fully Operational!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

[h3]We're happy to report that the cloud save feature should now be fully operational![/h3]

First, a heartfelt thank-you to everyone. [i]Lost for Swords[/i] only just launched, and we've already received incredible support and passionate feedback across multiple platforms — from Steam reviews to Heybox comments to Discussion Board posts, Some of you even left positive reviews despite experiencing cloud sync issues - and for that, we’re truly grateful for your patience.

We apologize for the earlier malfunction. As soon as we received your reports, we began working on a fix. Some of the potential solutions carried a risk of impacting existing save data, so it took us a little extra time to ensure everything was resolved safely and stably. Fortunately, things are now back on track, and you can safely switch devices with peace of mind.

Looking ahead, we’ll be monitoring all core features more closely to prevent similar issues. If you encounter any problems or have questions, feel free to reach out to us directly via the Discord server or simply leave a post in the official Discussion Board.

We’re also actively collecting feedback and are committed to continually improving the game. With your help, we’re confident [i]Lost for Swords[/i] will only get better from here.

Thank you once again for your patience and support.

MaxBytes & Astrolabe Games

April 17, 2025

notes.title: Lost For Swords is now released!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Greetings! Happy to announce that Lost for Swords officially launches on Steam today! Thank you for your incredible support along the way!

If you’re a fan of deckbuilder and some good roguelike dungeon-crawling action, we are sure Lost for Swords is the GAME for you! But before you begin your journey to conquer towers, our Tower Quartermaster has a few PSA to share:

[h3][b]Core Experience[/b][/h3]

At the heart of Lost for Swords is a fusion of deckbuilding and a procedurally-generated dungeon crawling experience. The layout of each dungeon floor is directly shaped by the cards in your deck!

The game features three playable characters and six unique towers (including a hidden one!). Each character has access to over 100 exclusive cards, and we’ve also added difficulty options and starter deck options to support deep customization and high replayability.

[h3][b]Community-designed Levels[/b][/h3]

Do you know that Lost for Swords supports community-designed levels?

Through the "Hero Academy" feature (unlocked after clearing the second tower), players can create and upload their own custom dungeons. If you can beat your own level, then it is good for sharing! — think Mario Maker's custom level system! With your creativity, the tower can keep expanding endlessly, and we can’t wait to see what you build!

[h3][b]Bug Reports and Feedback[/b][/h3]

We’ve worked hard to deliver a polished and complete experience at launch. That said, with so many cards and creative mechanics in play, a few bugs or inconsistencies may have slipped through. If you encounter anything unusual, please let us know via Discord or the Official Steam Discussion Board, we’d love your feedback and will roll out patches quickly! We promise that we are always actively listening.

Thank you again for your support, and we hope you enjoy our game!

MaxBytes and Astrolabe Games
April 16, 2025

[b]Here are the details:[/b]
[list]
[*] between rooms, you’re given the option to pick the next room layout to go to, with differing amounts of monsters and loot
[*] Rogue rework: updated mechanics (push), new mechanics (stealth), new and updated cards. See below for details

notes.title: Who’s The Boss Now?
notes.content:
[b]Hi there![/b]

New update for the Lost For Swords demo, including a rework of boss battles, new cards and lots of improvements!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/4f57b933a9ce486799a7a32d27eccba1952362bb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/eb7e19f56f654f0fc4ee342eced00ba6f1b89f66.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/3a8db2a553deefed593f00be8fc7e269c63341e1.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/85735cad127b85383aa8bd41a0f232e318e7159b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/756996450b7370dced27117dfbe452dcf1ef795b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/013a3fadf67d531332445f7935a97bc846d4fbe5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/4494b878f63ea529bf80b741e8de50d5749499de.png[/img]

[b]Here are the details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Boss rework:
[list]
    [*] bosses are immune to all damage while there are still other monsters on the board
    [*] rebalanced boss HP, Attack and Monster spawn rate
[/list][*] reworked most of the Sins and Sin related cards:
[list]
    [*] Sin interaction does not move hero onto the Sin anymore, but next to it
    [*] many Sins replace themselves by putting a card in their place after interaction
[/list][*] reworked Stalker to not swap place after attack: was too strong
[*] reworked Blessed Hammer: now triggers before monsters act
[*] reworked how damage is dealt to Monsters in deck: before, Monster defense always stayed at the Monster’s base value while in the deck, and never got reduced when they took damage. After the change, Monster defense in the deck behaves the same as on the board. And a Monster’s defense is reset to their base value after the deck gets shuffled between rooms
[*] Hero XP: each hero gains XP by completing floors of towers, unlocking cards
[*] renamed Feeble to Cowardly
[*] reworked Cowardly: a cowardly Monster can only flee when its their turn, not directly after getting attacked
[*] slightly reworked how Brute attack increase works: Brutes gets +2 attack when its their turn, if they have been attacked this turn (including unarmed attacks)
[*] Bloody Chest and Strange Chest have Eager
[*] reworked Doublecast into a Scroll (was a Spell)
[*] Mimic drops 20 Emeralds when defeated
[*] switched order of deck shuffling and auto-equip: auto-equip is first, then shuffling
[*] ability to unlock content in options menu
[*] better visuals when Monsters in deck are dealt damage
[*] show hero (and their HP) on card-find screen
[*] shuffle deck sound effect
[*] fixed rendering for many different resolutions, including Galaxy Z Fold5
[*] added particles for cards with quick or slow interact
[*] added particles for quick and slow cast spells
[/list]

New cards:
[list]
[*] Intimidation Ring
[*] Auramancer’s Amulet
[*] Ring Of Patience
[*] Gluttony
[*] Envy
[*] Force Multiplier
[*] Hungry Sword
[/list]

[b]Thanks for reading and see you at the next update! :)[/b]

Bye! (ʘ‿ʘ)╯

notes.title: Difficulty Modifiers and Starting Decks
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

Another update for Lost For Swords, this time focussing on difficulty and additional content! It adds multiple difficulty modifiers to the big Gathering Tower. Tone down the difficulty if the game seems too hard, or beat the tower to unlock higher difficulties!
The update also includes alternative starting decks for both Knight and Rogue, which you can find and unlock while on a tower run!

The update adds various new cards for the Knight, which enable different Hammer-focussed builds:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/c96efb8b2ac6428018b79163bd851371adea616e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/4056317636611c411869979d20858668d2cede3f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728549/bfde3ede34177e154a7b1cc9abdff12d03129511.png[/img]

(small Diablo II reference in there :D)

[b]Here's a detailed list of the changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]introduced difficulty modifiers for Gathering Tower: adjust the game to your liking, make it harder or easier. Unlock harder difficulties by beating the tower
[*]introduced alternative starting decks for Knight and Rogue! Unlock them by finding deck inventories in the tower
[*]reworked how slow weapons/hammers work when their attack target moves out of the way: attack is cancelled and weapon is not dropped → effectively buffs hammers and makes them much more viable!
[*]added quartermaster that stands in front of towers. Hands out alternative starter decks
[*]added quartermaster intro cutscene when first visiting tower
[*]added campfire scene when beating Gathering Tower
[*]captured Rogue call for help right when you enter the room, so you won’t miss them as easily
[*]buffed Spiked Armor: deals all of your Defense as damage
[*]buffed Atonement: flips Sins before destroying them
[*]increased all hero HP by 3
[*]starting with second backtracking on a floor, punishment “Tired” produces more punishing Fatigue cards
[*]reworked input buffering so it “sticks” to cards, not card locations[/list]
[b]New cards:[/b]
[list][*]Fear Dagger
[*]Solomon’s Hammer
[*]Hammer Artisan
[*]Blessed Hammer
[*]Goro’s Hammer
[*]Achilles’ Armor
[/list]

[b]Thanks for reading and see you at the next update! :)[/b]

Bye! (ʘ‿ʘ)╯

notes.title: Overworld Map, New Tower and Juice
notes.content:
[b]Hi there![/b]

A new update for the Lost For Swords demo just dropped! It includes a full rework of the systems and visuals outside of a tower run, including an overworld map. Furthermore, lots of improvements to help beginner players learn the game better, such as a second tower and better visual guides... and lots of other stuff too :)

Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Introduced overworld map
[*] Added second tower that serves as a better introduction to tower gameplay
[*] Reworked first fort
[*] Reworked objective system: defeat monsters to obtain winged key, which opens door to next floor
[*] NPCs and Bosses are more talkative
[*] Added options for disabling post-processing and particles/flashing
[*] Healer can raise your Max HP by 2 if you visit her fully healed
[*] Slightly increased base HP of Knight and Rogue
[*] Small HP Adjustments to Monsters and Props
[*] Visible healthbars for cards
[*] Renamed “Dungeon Deck” to “Monster Deck”
[*] Reworked Defiance to only trigger when hero is 8-neighbor
[*] Many visual improvements to movement and attacking
[*] Small changes to monster pathfinding
[*] Fixed Ethereal Shuriken returning to deck - thanks @Jam2020
[*] Fixed upgraded Reactive Armor not working as described - thanks @Jam2020
[*] Fixed Vainglory shuffling one too many Vanity into the deck - thanks @TheOneWhoWondersThere
[*] New Card: Subtle Body Charm
[/list]

Thanks for reading and see you at the next patch! :)

Bye! (ʘ‿ʘ)╯
